fieldValues.title: Every kind of meeting is one session record with a kind
fieldValues.decision_question: How are the different kinds of meeting recorded?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-15, in a clerked session; proposed in clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md). The owner instructed: record and hold.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every kind of meeting is recorded as one session record with a kind.
fieldValues.rationale: One way per goal: one session record and one clerk, never a tool per meeting.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a kind of meeting needs a field the session record cannot hold.
